verified_against: thermal_foundation-1.20.1-11.0.6.70.jar (embeds thermal_core-1.20.1-11.0.6.24.jar), thermal_expansion-1.20.1-11.0.1.29.jar, thermal_dynamics-1.20.1-11.0.1.23.jar, thermal_innovation-1.20.1-11.0.1.23.jar, thermal_cultivation-1.20.1-11.0.1.24.jar

chain.title: Raw Tin
chain.desc: Mine Tin Ore, which generates in overworld stone and deepslate; tin is the gateway metal for every Thermal machine.

chain.title: Tin Gear
chain.desc: Craft four tin ingots in a diamond shape around a single iron nugget.

chain.title: Machine Frame
chain.desc: Craft a tin gear surrounded by glass and iron ingots; this is the chassis every Thermal Expansion machine is built around.

chain.title: Redstone Flux Coil
chain.desc: Craft a gold ingot with two redstone dust diagonally; the universal power component in every machine and dynamo.

chain.title: Stirling Dynamo
chain.desc: Craft an RF Coil over an iron gear with stone and redstone; burns coal or charcoal to make your first Redstone Flux.

chain.title: Redstone Furnace
chain.desc: Machine Frame plus RF Coil, a copper gear, bricks and redstone; smelts faster than a vanilla furnace on RF alone.

chain.title: Pulverizer
chain.desc: Machine Frame plus RF Coil, a copper gear, flint and a piston; grinds ore into two dusts each, doubling metal yield.

chain.title: Redstone Servo
chain.desc: Craft redstone dust between iron ingots; the control part behind Thermal's unpowered devices and duct attachments.

chain.title: Arboreal Extractor
chain.desc: Craft a Redstone Servo with an iron gear, bucket, glass and planks, then place it against a rubberwood or jungle trunk to tap Latex.

chain.title: Cured Rubber
chain.desc: Turn a Latex Bucket into three Rubber, then smelt the Rubber; required for energy and fluid cells.

chain.title: Invar Ingot
chain.desc: Alloy two iron with one nickel, either as dusts in a furnace or directly in the Induction Smelter; the mid-tier gear metal.

chain.title: Induction Smelter
chain.desc: Machine Frame plus RF Coil, an invar gear, sand and a blast furnace; alloys metals and smelts ore with sand for bonus Rich Slag.

chain.title: Hardened Integral Components
chain.desc: Craft a gold gear with invar ingots, glass and redstone; drop it into a machine's augment slot to raise it to the Hardened tier.

chain.title: Redstone Flux Cell
chain.desc: Build an Energy Cell Frame from an electrum gear, lead and glass, then combine with an RF Coil, Cured Rubber and a redstone block to buffer power.

chain.title: Flux Capacitor
chain.desc: Craft an RF Coil with lead ingots and redstone; carries RF to recharge Thermal tools and armor in the field.

chain.title: Magmatic Dynamo
chain.desc: Craft an RF Coil with an invar gear and invar ingots; burns lava for a large step up in sustained power over the Stirling.

chain.title: Signalum Ingot
chain.desc: Alloy three copper, one silver and two redstone in the Induction Smelter; the first of the three tiering alloys.

chain.title: Reinforced Integral Components
chain.desc: Combine the Hardened kit with a signalum gear, electrum ingots and quartz to push a machine to the Reinforced tier.

chain.title: Multiservo Press
chain.desc: Machine Frame plus RF Coil, a constantan gear, an iron block and bronze; with a Gearworking Die it stamps ingots into gears automatically.

chain.title: Fluxbore
chain.desc: Craft a Drill Head over an RF Coil with gold and tin gears; an RF-powered pickaxe and shovel that accepts area-mining augments.

chain.title: Hardened Glass
chain.desc: Smelt obsidian, sand and quartz together in the Induction Smelter; the blast-resistant glass needed for the top upgrade kit.

chain.title: Lumium Ingot
chain.desc: Alloy three tin, one silver and two glowstone dust in the Induction Smelter; gates the Phytogenic Insolator and the Resonant kit.

chain.title: Enderium Ingot
chain.desc: Alloy three lead, one diamond and two ender pearls in the Induction Smelter; Thermal's endgame metal.

chain.title: Resonant Integral Components
chain.desc: Combine the Reinforced kit with a lumium gear, enderium ingots and Hardened Glass for the highest craftable machine tier.

notes: All 24 ids were verified against lang keys (item.thermal.* / block.thermal.*) and models in the downloaded jars; every crafted entry was additionally confirmed against its recipe JSON in data/thermal/recipes/, so the stated ingredients are from the jar, not a wiki. Note thermal_foundation ships thermal_core as a jar-in-jar and the lang files live under assets/thermal_foundation/ and assets/thermal_dynamics/ rather than assets/thermal/, so a naive scan of assets/thermal/lang returns nothing. Ids dropped: thermal:upgrade_augment_4 (Resonant+ Integral Components) exists as a lang key and model but has NO recipe anywhere in the five jars, so it is creative/config-gated and unsuitable as a quest goal; thermal:item_cell and thermal:item_cell_frame likewise have lang entries but no recipe in any scanned jar and were dropped. Machine tiering is done with augment kits inserted into a machine's augment slots, not by crafting separate tiered machine blocks - there is no thermal:hardened_machine_frame or similar, so quests should target the upgrade_augment_N items. Every machine except the Redstone Furnace family follows one pattern: Machine Frame + RF Coil + a tier-appropriate gear + two themed ingredients, which makes Machine Frame and RF Coil the natural hard gates for a quest chain. Alloys can be made either by hand-crafting dusts with a fire charge or in the Induction Smelter; the smelter route is the intended progression. Optional expansions if more entries are wanted, all verified present: thermal:wrench (Crescent Hammer, very early), thermal:machine_crucible (Magma Crucible, melts cobble into lava and pairs with the Magmatic Dynamo), thermal:machine_sawmill, thermal:machine_insolator (lumium gear), thermal:machine_crafter, thermal:machine_centrifuge, thermal:machine_pyrolyzer, thermal:energy_duct, thermal:fluid_cell, thermal:charge_bench, thermal:satchel, thermal:xp_crystal, thermal:flux_saw, thermal:flux_magnet, thermal:dynamo_compression, thermal:dynamo_numismatic, thermal:machine_speed_augment, thermal:rf_coil_augment.
